source_differences: Installed power: IBE 2012 43 MW vs IBE 2010 40 MW.
Height: IBE 2010 dam height 31.35 m vs IBE 2012 structure height 39.25 m (foundation 134.65 to roof 173.90 m a.s.l.), different definitions.
An earlier note on this record says NPP is about 4 km SE, from the en.wikipedia NPP coordinate (45.938333, 15.515556) it is about 4.8 km SE.

blocks.name: Powerhouse (outline from OpenStreetMap way 651093189)
info: 39.25 m from foundation (134.65 m) to top (173.90 m above sea level)

basis: powerhouse outline from OpenStreetMap way 651093189, which measures about 84 x 19 m and matches the published plan of about 85 x 20 m
model_basis.assumed: OpenStreetMap tags this outline as the whole plant. Its size matches the published powerhouse, so it is drawn as the powerhouse. The 5 spillway bays of 15 m with 3 m piers are in the sources, but the dam axis is not mapped, so the spillway is not drawn. The base is drawn at level 0 because ground and river bed elevations are not published.
